name: HackerOne (public GraphQL, backlog)
tier_rationale: Established company (HackerOne Inc.) with published terms, a privacy policy and a business offering (A8 trusted); no council statement names a HackerOne tier.

reliability.justification: Platform records are authoritative for HackerOne accounts (not queried in this build).

graphql.title: HackerOne public GraphQL user query (undocumented internal endpoint; BACKLOG, not in this build)

terms.quote: HackerOne public GraphQL is not in this build: an undocumented internal endpoint with terms 'unknown' and no trimmed fixture (legal_dpo, architect). BACKLOG.md keeps it until legal records its terms and a fixed read-only query with fixtures exists.

graphql.notes: Quote: binding council text (P100 cond 2). hackerone.com/graphql (research C0249). Backlog only: no module calls it in this build (P102 removed the host from dockerhub; P359 declares only SaaS forges). legal_dpo's floor allows only unauthenticated GETs for username checks (P113), so a read-only GraphQL POST needs a new decision.

notes: Shared seed for batches p2-G05-1, p2-G05-2: batches only extend it (hackerone__<suffix>.json: extra sources and error markers). Seeded so the hosts those batches declare resolve to one provider; nothing calls it in this build.
